notes.text: THIS QUEUE IS THE BATCH RECORD; there is no batch.yaml, matching both batches of the ICPERF campaign and both of GOAL-SEMBIN-fcb7a2. The opening decision is DEC-20260922-e9d35a and the write-once checkpoint shard is ledger/goals/GOAL-FROB-6333a9/checkpoints/BATCH-5286b0.yaml. Timestamps in this file are supplied by the authoring runtime at date granularity; this role holds no clock, and 00:00:00Z means 'on 2026-09-22' rather than midnight.

REVISION BEFORE PUBLICATION, RECORDED RATHER THAN SMOOTHED. The first draft of this queue omitted the opening act's card and declared the ledger archive with `source_task_ids: []`, on the reasoning that an opening archive closes no producer. `tools/research_dispatch.py` refused it: `tasks[0].archive.source_task_ids must be a nonempty text list`. THE SCHEMA WAS RIGHT AND THE REASONING WAS WRONG. Every archive follows a producer, and this one does too -- the producer is the /coordinate engagement that wrote the decision, the amendment, the correction, the checkpoint, the goal-head edit, this queue and the two archival cards. That act was real, it produced eight declared artifacts, and the only thing missing was its card. The first draft disclosed that absence as procedure_deviations PD-2 and called it tolerable. It was not tolerable, because the remedy was cheap: write the card. A disclosed deviation is not a substitute for correctness when correctness costs one card, and the dispatcher caught what the disclosure had excused. PD-2 on DEC-20260922-e9d35a is rewritten accordingly and now records a late-written card rather than a missing one.

IT WOULD HAVE MADE THE ERROR GO AWAY AND WOULD HAVE BEEN FALSE. TASK-20260920-956d12 produced the DESIGN PACKAGE -- the specification, the hypothesis, the proposal, DEC-20260920-cf8ded and the two 2026-09-20 cards -- and archived them on 2026-09-20 at commit 14ef07b83, with a receipt whose staged_paths lists exactly those. NONE of the eight paths TASK-20260922-0e3b58 stages appears in it. Declaring it the source would assert that this archive follows that producer, which is precisely the declared-set-versus-actual-set mismatch that has GOAL-ICEX-001 and GOAL-SIG-001 in 'needs repair' and that ITEM-5 of DEC-20260922-e9d35a repairs on this very goal. It would additionally re-enlist a COMPLETED archive as a live source, which is the confusion CORR-20260922-9e402f exists to end. Repairing a schema complaint with a false attribution, on the same goal where a false archival attribution is the thing being corrected, would have been the worst available answer.

(1) SELF-REFERENCE -- keep one card that both produces and archives, with source_task_ids naming itself. It would pass the schema and is arguably true, but it reads to any later auditor as a dodge, it cannot be tested from a session with no shell, and it collapses the producer/archive distinction that makes an archive checkable at all. (2) DROP THE ARCHIVE CARD FROM THE QUEUE and treat the opening commit as the act that publishes the queue. This is the more tempting option and it is rejected for a concrete cost: `archived_by: TASK-20260922-0e3b58` binds all eight opening artifacts, and an archive that no queue declares is an archive `research_dispatch.py` never verifies -- so the opening package would be committed but never verified, which is the ICEX/SIG defect wearing the opposite face. The chosen structure keeps the verification chain intact and costs one identifier.

THIS IS THE LOAD-BEARING ORDERING OF THE WHOLE BATCH. experiments/EXP-FROB-30006a/runs/ contains only .gitkeep, so zero outcomes have been observed. TODAY the search-mode declaration and the pruning-branch control differential are an additive amendment that weakens no threshold. AFTER the first run they would be a change to a success criterion following an observed outcome, which agents/coordinator.md prohibits outright -- so the same repair does not become late, it becomes UNAVAILABLE. That is why the ledger archive precedes the run and why the run's dispatch preconditions require the archive's receipt to verify rather than merely to have been attempted.

Two defects, both found by reading EV-FROB-b6e1e9 against the frozen contract, and both checkable by reading the contract alone -- and both independently corroborated by the dispatching session before the first commit. D1: the primary metric is conflicts divided by 2^{ml}/m!, and the contract names NO WDSat search mode -- the strings XORGAUSS, XG and -x do not occur in it, and independent_variables lists n, m, V_kind, factor and seed without the mode. EV-FROB-b6e1e9 measures that mode at 69x (n=19) and 220x (n=23) on comparable Koblitz PDP instances. A 69-to-220x knob on the numerator against a basis_blind window 0.02 wide. D2: the pruning branch of the frozen decision_rule reads only r_s, never r_r, while the basis_blind branch tests both -- so any effect COMMON TO BOTH ARMS returns `pruning`, which is a claim specifically about Frobenius stability. C-RAND exists as a declared control and the rule does not consult it where it would discriminate. EV-FROB-b6e1e9 is what makes D2 live rather than hypothetical: under XG a baseline with NO Frobenius specialness sat 12x and 24x BELOW its own orbit-naive enumeration bound, while the same instances in plain mode sat 5.6x and 9.0x ABOVE it, and 2^{ml}/m! is an enumeration-naive bound of exactly that kind.

STATED HERE AND NOT ONLY IN THE AMENDMENT, because a queue is what an executor reads. EV-FROB-b6e1e9's figures are at n=19 and 23, on a NON-LINEAR orbit union of a random subspace, at m=2, against a 2^{2l'} enumeration bound. This contract is at n=41 and 43, on the LINEAR ker g(sigma) and a size-matched random control, at m=2 and 3, against 2^{ml}/m!. Different object, different cells, DIFFERENT NULL -- the same three differences DEC-20260922-e9d35a ITEM-1 refuses to let any status move across. THE AMENDMENT DOES NOT ASSUME THE TRANSFER HOLDS; it assumes only that it is POSSIBLE, which justifies a control and nowhere near justifies a prediction. A reader who believes the transfer fails should still want A-1 and A-2: an undeclared solver mode on the primary metric and a control-free pruning branch are defects independent of any transfer.

SEVEN CARDS. The first draft carried four and declared the review round deferred, on the reasoning that its joints could not be OWNED without identifiers and that the gap blocked only the CLAIM -- 'NOT blocked: the batch, the executor card, the run itself.' THE DISPATCHER REFUSED THE QUEUE AND SHOWED THAT CLAIM WAS FALSE: `_validate_review_chains` (lines 765-812) refuses the whole queue when a producer carries `review_required: true` and its chain is incomplete, so the missing cards blocked the queue and therefore the run. The impediment was right about what was owed and wrong about what it stopped; it is discharged and its error preserved on the goal head under `impediments_discharged`. THE ROUND IS NOW WRITTEN IN FULL: coordination/review/frob-20260922-5286b0/review-plan.yaml, written before any reviewer and before the measurement exists, six joints each owned by exactly one reviewer with a worked attack, a proves-too-much control on the random-V arm, and a blind re-derivation whose independence is STRUCTURAL -- the validator's read scope excludes every path in its own blind_from. WHAT IS STILL NOT REACHED: an evidence record, for want of an EV-FROB-* identifier, so C1 and C2 both stay OPEN at the end of this batch. That is a declared remainder, not a hidden one.

FIRST DEFECT, FOUND BY READING THE CARD: TASK-20260920-66a30e declares four artifact_paths for the run package and names archived_by TASK-20260920-956d12 -- an archive that COMPLETED 2026-09-20T08:23:48Z at commit 14ef07b83 and whose staged_paths contains none of them (it staged the design package; runs/.gitkeep is a directory marker, not the runs). So the run package had NO owning archival task and the owner named had already closed. SECOND DEFECT, FOUND WHEN THIS QUEUE WAS RENDERED AND STRICTLY WORSE: the card is UNDISPATCHABLE. Its artifact_paths and write_scope are the same four-entry list and two entries are directories, which validate_artifact_path refuses while validate_scope would have allowed. CONSEQUENCE: GOAL-FROB-6333a9 HAS NEVER HAD A DISPATCHABLE EXECUTOR CARD, so its two days at current_batch_id null were not merely a missing queue. THE REMEDY IS ONE SUPERSEDING CARD, NOT TWO PATCHES. The first draft of this queue kept the merged card here with an `archived_by_corrected` overlay and a warning that a dispatcher reading only the card's own field would repeat the defect -- which is a live trap documented rather than removed. TASK-20260922-cd6f21 carries the corrected owner and the conforming paths natively; the merged card is immutable, untouched, and absent from this queue. CORR-20260922-9e402f records both defects and both remedies, as ONE correction: two defects of one merged record, both found before that correction was published, splitting which would create a record whose only distinguishing property is the minute each was noticed.

`tools/goal_lanes.py lanes GOAL-FROB-6333a9` reported NO LANES at this batch's opening. That is a SNAPSHOT AND NOT A LOCK: another session may open a lane on this goal at any time without this one being told, and the correct response is `git fetch` then re-list, never an assumption. Every card here writes inside its own directory and the goal head is edited additively inside this batch's own ledger archive, so a second lane collides with nothing but the head. Claim a lane per task before launching its subagent and release it with an outcome on return.

Every card here sets fallback_allowed TRUE with a stated reason rather than inheriting `false` from the AGENTS.md template and being amended after the work runs. That default is right for the contract and wrong for this machine, which holds no credentialed adapter backend; BATCH-a33cda needed three amendments to learn it (DEC-20260916-7b2235, DEC-20260916-bec4b8). Every card also pre-declares the degraded_requirement it expects (model_verified false, no probeable backend). `tools/research_dispatch.py` inference_advisories reports such mismatches at render time; this queue is written so it has nothing to say except on the pre-existing executor card, which is NOT edited and whose divergence is declared on its own entry.

It cannot reach a statement about any deployed or challenge curve: the cells are n = 41 and 43, claim_tier toy, certificate_semantics none, and the contract forbids attack and DL recovery. It cannot discharge C1 or C2 of GOAL-FROB-6333a9 by itself, because both require a committed decision on reviewed evidence and the review round is not staffed here. It cannot reach n = 131 or any cryptographic degree. And if a pruning verdict were ever promoted as CONTRADICTING prior FROB negatives, AGENTS.md rule 12 requires review-breakthrough at max, which is degradable false and cannot be served in this environment -- so such a CLAIM would stay un-promoted while the campaign stays active. That is a limit on the claim, never on the campaign, and no cheaper tier is pre-authorized here for a result nobody has seen.

handoff.objective: Compose the two blinded reviewers' per-joint verdicts into ONE Coordinator decision, DEC-20260922-f4d910, and commit it with both review reports in one isolated ledger commit; then verify the receipt against Git, push, and refresh the PR.
handoff.uncertainty_reduced: NONE by measurement. What it resolves is whether the primary cell's verdict may be cited at all, and at what scope -- a judgement on validity, not a new observation.
constraints: CA-1: COMPOSE; do not vote-count. Each reviewer owned a strict subset of the joints and could not see the others. `Both reviewers concurred` is not a finding about the claim; it is two findings about disjoint joints.
CA-2: Run `python3 tools/check_review_independence.py` BEFORE composing and record its result in the decision. A failure voids the round's independence and the composition waits.

CA-3: Compare the outcome against the recorded prior EXPLICITLY, citing PD-R1 -- the prior was written by the session that also composed EV-FROB-b6e1e9 and found both contract defects, so concurrence is weaker evidence than it looks and the decision must say so.
CA-4: An instrument defect is NOT a mathematical result. If J1, J2 or J4 breaks, record an invalid run set returned to the executor with concrete defects.

CA-5: Do NOT move H-FROB-a5bf86 unless the composition supports it at the artifacts' scope, and never `reject_scoped` on one unreplicated cell -- `weaken` plus replication. Any adverse transition needs the strongest checkable refutation artifact archived first.
CA-6: Fill `knowledge_promotion`. A single primary cell is neither `replicated` nor `strong`, so state a concrete not_warranted reason unless that changes.
CA-7: Stage only the declared paths, path by path. `git add -A` is forbidden. Merge origin/main first -- merge, never rebase.
CA-8: Scope the decision to the tested curves, degrees, arity, solver commit, modes, replicate count and budget. n = 41 and 43 is not n = 131.
CA-9: ZERO RUNS. This is not a /run.
deliverables: ledger/decisions/DEC-20260922-f4d910.yaml -- the composed decision: per-joint verdicts and their owners, the independence-check result, the prior-versus-outcome comparison citing PD-R1, the validity ruling, the scope statement, knowledge_promotion, and exactly one next_action

handoff.composition_and_archive_in_one_card: DISCLOSED, NOT HIDDEN. This card writes DEC-20260922-f4d910 and also commits it, so it archives its own output -- the shape PD-2 argues against, having caught this batch doing it at its opening. Accepted for two stated reasons, neither being that it is better: no fifth handoff identifier is minted, and `_validate_review_chains` requires exactly ONE ledger archive over the reviews, so the correct split is a separate non-archive COMPOSE card listed as an additional source of this one -- a real structure, what a later batch should use, needing an identifier this session does not have. THE COST IS CONCRETE: the composition has no write scope or completion gate of its own while it is being written, and its artifacts are unowned until this same card commits them.
